title: US History: Presidents in Order
description: For beginning US history learners: presidents numbered 1 through 47, with years, party and one key fact. Nonconsecutive presidencies receive separate cards. Current term information is dated October 9, 2026.

sources.name: National Archives: presidential research resources
sources.license: Public-domain US government material; original summaries

sources.name: White House: Donald J. Trump biography
sources.license: Public-domain US government material; original factual summary

cards.front: Who was president number 1? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 1. George Washington. Years: 1789-1797. Party: Unaffiliated. Key fact: Established the precedent of voluntarily leaving office after two terms.

cards.front: Who was president number 2? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 2. John Adams. Years: 1797-1801. Party: Federalist. Key fact: Was the first president to live in the White House.

cards.front: Who was president number 3? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 3. Thomas Jefferson. Years: 1801-1809. Party: Democratic-Republican. Key fact: His administration acquired the Louisiana Territory from France in 1803.

cards.front: Who was president number 4? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 4. James Madison. Years: 1809-1817. Party: Democratic-Republican. Key fact: Was president during the War of 1812.

cards.front: Who was president number 5? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 5. James Monroe. Years: 1817-1825. Party: Democratic-Republican. Key fact: Announced the Monroe Doctrine in 1823.

cards.front: Who was president number 6? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 6. John Quincy Adams. Years: 1825-1829. Party: Democratic-Republican; later associated with National Republicans. Key fact: Was chosen president by the House of Representatives after the 1824 election produced no electoral-vote majority.

cards.front: Who was president number 7? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 7. Andrew Jackson. Years: 1829-1837. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Signed the Indian Removal Act in 1830.

cards.front: Who was president number 8? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 8. Martin Van Buren. Years: 1837-1841. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Was the first president born after the Declaration of Independence.

cards.front: Who was president number 9? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 9. William Henry Harrison. Years: 1841. Party: Whig. Key fact: Died about one month after taking office, the shortest presidency.

cards.front: Who was president number 10? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 10. John Tyler. Years: 1841-1845. Party: Whig at accession; unaffiliated after expulsion from the party. Key fact: Was the first vice president to become president after a president's death.

cards.front: Who was president number 11? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 11. James K. Polk. Years: 1845-1849. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Was president during the Mexican-American War.

cards.front: Who was president number 12? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 12. Zachary Taylor. Years: 1849-1850. Party: Whig. Key fact: Had been a major general in the Mexican-American War.

cards.front: Who was president number 13? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 13. Millard Fillmore. Years: 1850-1853. Party: Whig. Key fact: Signed the Fugitive Slave Act of 1850 as part of the Compromise of 1850.

cards.front: Who was president number 14? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 14. Franklin Pierce. Years: 1853-1857. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Signed the Kansas-Nebraska Act in 1854.

cards.front: Who was president number 15? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 15. James Buchanan. Years: 1857-1861. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Was president when the first Southern states seceded after the 1860 election.

cards.front: Who was president number 16? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 16. Abraham Lincoln. Years: 1861-1865. Party: Republican; reelected on the National Union ticket. Key fact: Issued the Emancipation Proclamation during the Civil War.

cards.front: Who was president number 17? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 17. Andrew Johnson. Years: 1865-1869. Party: Democratic; elected vice president on the National Union ticket. Key fact: Was impeached by the House in 1868 and acquitted by the Senate.

cards.front: Who was president number 18? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 18. Ulysses S. Grant. Years: 1869-1877. Party: Republican. Key fact: Supported federal enforcement of civil rights during Reconstruction.

cards.front: Who was president number 19? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 19. Rutherford B. Hayes. Years: 1877-1881. Party: Republican. Key fact: Took office after the disputed 1876 election was resolved through an electoral commission and congressional proceedings.

cards.front: Who was president number 20? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 20. James A. Garfield. Years: 1881. Party: Republican. Key fact: Died after being shot by an assassin during his first year in office.

cards.front: Who was president number 21? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 21. Chester A. Arthur. Years: 1881-1885. Party: Republican. Key fact: Signed the Pendleton Civil Service Reform Act in 1883.

cards.front: Who was president number 22? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 22. Grover Cleveland. Years: 1885-1889. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Served his first of two nonconsecutive presidencies.

cards.front: Who was president number 23? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 23. Benjamin Harrison. Years: 1889-1893. Party: Republican. Key fact: Signed the Sherman Antitrust Act in 1890.

cards.front: Who was president number 24? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 24. Grover Cleveland. Years: 1893-1897. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Returned to office as the 24th president after previously serving as the 22nd.

cards.front: Who was president number 25? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 25. William McKinley. Years: 1897-1901. Party: Republican. Key fact: Was president during the Spanish-American War of 1898.

cards.front: Who was president number 26? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 26. Theodore Roosevelt. Years: 1901-1909. Party: Republican. Key fact: Became president at age 42, the youngest person to assume the office.

cards.front: Who was president number 27? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 27. William Howard Taft. Years: 1909-1913. Party: Republican. Key fact: Later served as chief justice of the United States.

cards.front: Who was president number 28? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 28. Woodrow Wilson. Years: 1913-1921. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Led the United States during its participation in World War I.

cards.front: Who was president number 29? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 29. Warren G. Harding. Years: 1921-1923. Party: Republican. Key fact: Died in office in 1923 and was succeeded by Calvin Coolidge.

cards.front: Who was president number 30? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 30. Calvin Coolidge. Years: 1923-1929. Party: Republican. Key fact: Signed the Indian Citizenship Act in 1924.

cards.front: Who was president number 31? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 31. Herbert Hoover. Years: 1929-1933. Party: Republican. Key fact: Was president when the 1929 stock market crash occurred and the Great Depression began.

cards.front: Who was president number 32? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 32. Franklin D. Roosevelt. Years: 1933-1945. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Was elected president four times, more than any other person.

cards.front: Who was president number 33? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 33. Harry S. Truman. Years: 1945-1953. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Succeeded Roosevelt in 1945 and was president at the end of World War II.

cards.front: Who was president number 34? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 34. Dwight D. Eisenhower. Years: 1953-1961. Party: Republican. Key fact: Signed the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956, advancing the Interstate Highway System.

cards.front: Who was president number 35? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 35. John F. Kennedy. Years: 1961-1963. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Was president during the Cuban Missile Crisis in 1962.

cards.front: Who was president number 36? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 36. Lyndon B. Johnson. Years: 1963-1969. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Signed the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and Voting Rights Act of 1965.

cards.front: Who was president number 37? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 37. Richard Nixon. Years: 1969-1974. Party: Republican. Key fact: Resigned in 1974 during the Watergate scandal.

cards.front: Who was president number 38? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 38. Gerald Ford. Years: 1974-1977. Party: Republican. Key fact: Became president without having been elected president or vice president.

cards.front: Who was president number 39? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 39. Jimmy Carter. Years: 1977-1981. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Helped broker the Camp David Accords in 1978.

cards.front: Who was president number 40? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 40. Ronald Reagan. Years: 1981-1989. Party: Republican. Key fact: Signed the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty with the Soviet Union in 1987.

cards.front: Who was president number 41? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 41. George H. W. Bush. Years: 1989-1993. Party: Republican. Key fact: Was president during the 1991 Gulf War.

cards.front: Who was president number 42? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 42. Bill Clinton. Years: 1993-2001. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Signed the North American Free Trade Agreement Implementation Act in 1993.

cards.front: Who was president number 43? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 43. George W. Bush. Years: 2001-2009. Party: Republican. Key fact: Was president during the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks.

cards.front: Who was president number 44? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 44. Barack Obama. Years: 2009-2017. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Was the first African American president.

cards.front: Who was president number 45? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 45. Donald Trump. Years: 2017-2021. Party: Republican. Key fact: Signed legislation establishing the United States Space Force in 2019.

cards.front: Who was president number 46? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 46. Joe Biden. Years: 2021-2025. Party: Democratic. Key fact: Signed the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act in 2021.

cards.front: Who was president number 47? Give years, party and one key fact.
cards.back: 47. Donald Trump. Years: 2025-present, as of October 9, 2026. Party: Republican. Key fact: Became the second person, after Grover Cleveland, to hold nonconsecutive presidencies.
